act.long_title: An Act to define and amend the law relating to Promissory Notes, Bills of Exchange and Cheques.

section.heading: Offences to be compoundable
section.html: Notwithstanding anything contained in the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (2 of 1974), every offence punishable under this Act shall be compoundable].
section.text: Notwithstanding anything contained in the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (2 of 1974), every offence punishable under this Act shall be compoundable].
